title: Real Life Analysis of new PPAR agonists for treatment of PBC
summary: Primary biliary cholangitis is a chronic disease of the bile ducts. Treatment consists of ursodeoxycholic acid, a bile acid. If this alone does not lead to a good response with normalization of bile values, there are now new drugs that can be used in addition to the treatment.  There are no data analyses available yet on the use of these new drugs in everyday clinical practice. We therefore want to test the efficacy of the new drugs in everyday clinical practice.

interventions.name:
PBC patients treated with Elafibranor or Seladelpar

Documentation of laboratory values/therapy 1 year before switching, when switching to Elafibranor/Seladelpar and thereafter in all available follow-up examinations until 1 year after switching

PBC patients treated with bezafibrat

Documentation of laboratory values/therapy 1 year before switching, when switching to bezafibrate and thereafter in all available follow-up examinations until 1 year after switching

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
PBC diagnosis and second line treatment with PPAR agonists
Exclusion criteria:
Liver transplant, AIH
